entries.title: Web addresses in cards open with a click or a tap
entries.body: A web address a crewmate writes as plain words in a card, such as the sign-in page in a step, is now a link on your computer and on your iPhone and iPad. Click it, tap it or press Enter on it to open it in your browser.

picture.alt: A card asking for an API key, whose first step's address is underlined as a link
